## Context / Problem
The 18 Terraform files below contain repeated, obvious, historical, or stale comments identified by the audit and revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`. Shortening them must preserve IAM, monitoring, and cross-file contracts.

## Approach
Edit only standalone comments and blank lines in the declared files. Preserve HCL attributes, heredoc values, resource names, tags, and outputs byte-for-byte. Replace migration/incident narration with current operator rationale.

## Scope
- `acm.tf` — Preserve wildcard-certificate ownership, DNS renewal, lifecycle protection, and `auth_host.tf` consumption.
- `iam_bridge_metrics.tf`, `iam_s2.tf`, `iam_s4a.tf`, `iam_s7.tf`, and `iam.tf` — Preserve each file's current resource/no-resource boundary, repo-scoped OIDC and drift roles, Session Manager posture, SSM/KMS conditions, CloudWatch limitation, Claude-only Bedrock/profile bounds, and profile plus underlying-model ARNs.
- `monitoring_1fa8.tf`, `monitoring_88ab.tf`, and `monitoring_9ea3.tf` — Preserve g2p cadence, granular-versus-aggregate overlap, current SNS/missing-data behavior, and the end-to-end `/mcp` 401 heartbeat with its description limit.
- `monitoring_autodeploy.tf` — Cover all current deploy-error, review-interrupt, root-disk, gate-scratch, Docker-capacity/BuildKit/unaccounted-byte, journald, `/var/tmp`, and writable-container-layer alarms. Preserve namespaces, metrics, dimensions, publishers, thresholds/windows, missing-data behavior, SNS actions, and runbooks. For writable containers preserve the single Docker-budget/internal-share contract; distinct percent and reaper signals; exited-versus-running diagnosis; 300-second, 3-period, 2-datapoint windows with `>85` and `<1`; breaching missing data; and publishing—but not alarming on—quota enforceability until XFS `pquota` is enabled by reboot. The one-datapoint/2-of-4 text mismatch belongs to `curricular-ulcerous-urson`.
- `monitoring_bridge.tf`, `monitoring_eb6e.tf`, `monitoring_foxterrier.tf`, `monitoring_s4b.tf`, `monitoring_s5.tf`, and `monitoring_ws7.tf` — Preserve each metric's dimensions, model IDs, rate math, complementary role, windows, healthy-zero/missing-data exceptions, and SNS actions.
- `monitoring.tf` — Preserve shared SNS, out-of-band confirmation, complementary Gerrit/EC2 health, non-owning backup assertion, distinct capacity/debris alarms, and `variables.tf` region ownership.
- `oidc.tf` — Preserve account-singleton ownership, API-required thumbprint, and both role consumers.

Consumers include Terraform, `observability.sh`, `container-cap.sh`, `docker-storage-cap.sh`, `compose-up.sh`, monitoring tests, the review-bot runbook, and operators. Custom metrics match only on namespace/name/dimensions; most host counters publish healthy zero so silence breaches, with documented bridge/traffic exceptions. Never introduce a second overlapping Docker cap, treat quota-enforceability as an incident before reboot, or advise manual deletion under `overlay2`.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The leaf commit changes only the permitted comments/docstrings or blank lines in the declared files; executable/configuration data and exact behavior-bearing directives remain unchanged.
- [x] Every Scope constraint and consumer contract has a PASS row with concrete before/after citations in a leaf-linked TSV semantic matrix authored by a reviewer who did not write the remediation.
- [x] Every edited block has an independent `bloat-removal` PASS row confirming that redundant, obvious, duplicated, stale, or historical prose was removed while current rationale remained.
- [x] Recorded focused checks pass at the leaf commit.
- [x] The path-scoped `git diff --check` passes at the leaf commit.
- [x] Repository lint passes at the leaf commit.
- [x] Missing or FAIL semantic rows block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded content-only guards, focused checks, path-scoped diff check, and worktree-venv lint. The independent matrix, not exact prose matching, judges semantic preservation.
